title: On the Göllnitz-Gordon-Andrews identities via commutative algebra
summary: The Göllnitz-Gordon-Andrews identities generalize the classical partition identities discovered independently by H. Göllnitz and B. Gordon. These are Rogers-Ramanujan-type identities involving generating functions of partitions satisfying certain kinds of difference conditions on the one hand and infinite periodic products on the other. In 2021, Afsharijoo provided a commutative algebra proof of the Rogers-Ramanujan-Gordon identities.
